policy: Every listed scenario is Phase 1 acceptance. A @wip, missing, unmatched or non-passing scenario fails test:bdd:phase1; do not narrow this list to make the gate green.

scenarios.proves: Temporary credential is single-use, expires at the source-backed 72-hour default, forces password change and never leaks secrets.
Personal data entry is rejected until required consent is recorded.
Withdrawal is recorded and starts the configured retention evaluation.
Identifier ciphertext and blind-index duplicate review do not silently merge people.
A supported fallback identifier is retained and only existing indexes are used.
Identifier views are masked for officers and absent for union/TA/institutional audiences.
Events and application logs contain neither raw personal data nor NRC-shaped values.
Retention behavior preserves pseudonymous transaction facts and surfaces unresolved conflicts.
Member inspection is read-only and logs no other members' personal data.
Test mode accepts only the documented synthetic identifier pattern.
Real-data startup rejects an unapproved residency region.
Purge-to-seed removes tenant data, restores seed data and writes audit evidence.
Statutory register fields and consent-dependent identifiers retain distinct, reviewable basis behavior.
Public register inspection exposes only configured statutory fields and records a privacy-safe session.
Member inspection remains free and privacy-safe.
By-law inspection exposes the applicable version and no member data.
Access to another member's account data requires the defined authority and scope.
Union/TA users see assigned cohort gaps but no member-level personal data.
Delegation revocation removes access while preserving past audit actions.
State, event and outbox commit atomically or all roll back.
Same logical command ID and payload replays the original result once.
Same command ID with changed semantic content is rejected.
Stale writes preserve both inputs in the reconciliation path.
Cross-tenant command access is denied and audited without mutation.
Cross-tenant reads reveal no other organization's record.
UI telemetry is separate from the append-only business audit trail.
Institutional read-only roles cannot mutate cooperative source records.
The client cannot assign approval, authority or verified state.
Domain events are append-only at the database boundary.
Server authorization ignores forged role headers.
Offline occurred time and server recorded time remain distinct.
Validation runs preserve the rule version used at execution.
Persona navigation exposes URL-addressable workspace routes.
Route navigation manages focus and preserves URL state across reload.
Rendered routes do not leak enum values or unsupported claims.
Verified status communicates scope, verifier, version and assurance class.
Status is communicated by shape, color and text together.
Blocked actions explain themselves accessibly and retain focus.
Demo controls remain separate from product screens and require confirmation.
Synthetic seed values are never presented as real records.
Provenance drawer is keyboard accessible and complete.
Institution audience wording does not overstate cooperative verification.
